parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The IDs of the resources.

You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource.

Valid values:

- **apiGroup**

- **plugin**

- **app**

- **api**

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: Specify the object tags to which the rule applies. You can specify multiple tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key.

The value of N ranges from 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of the tag. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the corresponding **Tag.N.Key** parameter.

You can specify up to 20 tag values.
